subject: adding new items to previously obtained starting parameters

messages.author: 8a9dc1e734eac985
messages.subject: adding new items to previously obtained starting parameters
parts:
When fitting a model to new data I would like to use previously obtained starting parameters even if some new items were added. I have more than 1k items in the itempool. I am sure adding the new itemparameters with dummy values would still make convergence much faster than doing it without starting params.

library(mirt)

a <- rlnorm(20, .2, .2)
d <- rnorm(20)
dat <- simdata(a, d, N = 1000, itemtype='2PL')

mod <- mirt(dat, 1)
coef(mod, simplify=TRUE)
sv <- mod2values(mod)

mod2 <- mirt(dat, 1, pars = sv)

a <- rlnorm(22, .2, .2)
d <- rnorm(22)
dat <- simdata(a, d, N = 1000, itemtype='2PL')

#how to add the two new items to sv so that this would run?
mod3 <- mirt(dat, 1, pars = sv)

Many thanks.
Balázs

messages.author: 71bfb5f1e96782a8
messages.subject: Re: adding new items to previously obtained starting parameters
parts:
you can do this:

1. parameters = mirt(dat, 1, pars = "values")
2. change parameters table as you like. set est = FALSE to fix specific parameters
3. mod = mirt(dat, 1, pars = parameters)

messages.subject: Re: adding new items to previously obtained starting parameters
parts: It's not elegant, but it works now:

library(mirt)

a <- rlnorm(20, .2, .2)
d <- rnorm(20)
dat <- simdata(a, d, N = 1000, itemtype='2PL')

mod <- mirt(dat, 1)

dat <- simdata(a, d, N = 10000, itemtype='2PL')

groupRows<-tail(sv,2)
sv<-head(sv,nrow(sv)-2)
inames<-setdiff(colnames(dat),sv$item) #new items
for(i in 1:length(inames)){
  
  row<-data.frame(group='all', item=inames[i], class='dich', name='a1', parnum=i, value=1, lbound=-Inf, ubound=Inf, est=TRUE, prior.type='none', prior_1=NaN, prior_2=NaN)
  sv<-rbind(sv,row)
  
  row<-data.frame(group='all', item=inames[i], class='dich', name='d', parnum=i, value=0, lbound=-Inf, ubound=Inf, est=TRUE, prior.type='none', prior_1=NaN, prior_2=NaN)
  sv<-rbind(sv,row)
  
  row<-data.frame(group='all', item=inames[i], class='dich', name='g', parnum=i, value=0, lbound=0, ubound=1, est=FALSE, prior.type='none', prior_1=NaN, prior_2=NaN)
  sv<-rbind(sv,row)
  
  row<-data.frame(group='all', item=inames[i], class='dich', name='u', parnum=i, value=1, lbound=0, ubound=1, est=FALSE, prior.type='none', prior_1=NaN, prior_2=NaN)
  sv<-rbind(sv,row)
  
}
sv<-rbind(sv,groupRows)
sv$parnum=1:nrow(sv)
